set.body: Owner: ScalaFIM image geometry/value adapters and their direct consumers. Required before adopting current image4s incremental NIfTI output. Current image4s Sampled binds a sample-space type and explicit value semantics; frame unit/convention and ephemeral/persistent identity are structural. The ordinary image-module compatibility compile produces 84 errors against the unmodified native sources. An isolated seven-file syntax/semantic migration compiles, but JVM image tests report 35/247 failures and JS 33/234, including sparse mask construction, ROI selection, resampling, equality, and readback. Existing NeuroSpace/VolumeSpace are opaque aliases and GridCompatibility relies on ==; current SampleSpace equals is runtime identity and separately constructed legacy spaces use fresh ephemeral owners. Do not replace this with raw affine equality or global frame interning just to turn tests green. Explicitly define legacy numeric-grid compatibility versus scientifically identified frame alignment, retain owners through derived spaces, and audit downstream comparisons and persisted reopening. Keep undeclared generic legacy image values distinct from Continuous/Categorical/Mask; require explicit semantic conversion. Acceptance: baseline-versus-candidate full image JVM/JS gates, owner-isolation/unit/convention/axis tests, selected/ROI/sparse/resampling correctness, and direct dataset/fit/application qualification. Reuse upstream checked dimension refinement image4s bd-01M23PZVZKGA7CY5A2T8F17WSN. Isolated candidate /private/tmp/scalafim-output-resume-1; no native source or provider pin changes. This is an implementation prerequisite, not a completed migration.
set.title: Migrate canonical image value and frame-identity contracts before incremental output adoption
